mission: Distinguish structural cycle failure from normal recovery noise at the exact V11 first-watch entries; no entry optimization
status: Exploratory continuation after V11 inspection; not an untouched holdout
inputs: Existing V11 daily/native caches and first-watch observations from original V1 snapshots; no network data or denied V3/V4/verify_cache actions
context: confirmed W+2W, primary phases,200native warmup; original first fresh cross only
primary_horizon: fixed arm+126 session common endpoint; retained skipped and incomplete original watches; completed filled episodes for exit contrasts
structural_level: min completed daily low from arm-20 through signal inclusive; minus0.5 daily ATR known at signal, fixed for life of trade

policy_logic.HOLD: common endpoint, no stop; reference not recommendation
policy_logic.ATR6: entry-fixed6 daily ATR hard stop; matched wider-risk reference
policy_logic.STRUCTURE_ATR6: same6ATR hard stop plus daily close below fixed structural level, next open
policy_logic.STRUCTURE_MOMENTUM_ATR6: same6ATR hard stop plus close below structural level AND last completed lower histogram<0, next open
policy_logic.STAGED_ATR6: STRUCTURE_MOMENTUM_ATR6 plus first weekly K/D bear cross after a NEW completed weekly K>=80 during position, next open

costs: 0.05% each side,10bp total multiplicative;30bp sensitivity without new triggers
execution: opening gap stop before pending market exit; entry-day stop; no intraday highs on stop day counted unless order established; close-trigger exits next open; no reentry primary
analysis: gain preservation and stop recovery opportunity cost
same-stock single-position equity, cash0, no annual liquidation
accounting: adjusted-price proxies; not audited cash-dividend or broker fills; one unit account, not position recommendation
